In production with 18 championships and 100+ registered drivers.
Python, Flask and PostgreSQL with Clean Architecture, 2,000+ automated tests, CI/CD and monitoring.
description1:
Built the content ingestion pipeline of a streaming platform from scratch, migrated it from Python to Go (processing went from minutes to seconds per item), and designed a vector-based recommendation system.
Designing and building a loan management system for a lending company, which replaces a legacy desktop application, with a unified data model over several separate PostgreSQL databases and a server-rendered web interface.
Backend work on an internal document search tool for a consulting firm, using vector search.
Backend features in TypeScript with Clean Architecture for a low-code platform, plus UI/UX testing and basic penetration testing.
